item.title: Local Government Districts - 2022 (Final Recommendations) source files
item.subtitle: Local Government Districts / Local Government Boundary Commission for Northern Ireland, Land & Property Services
provider: Local Government Boundary Commission for Northern Ireland
item.description: Northern Ireland's 11 Local Government Districts as set out in the Local Government Boundary Commission's Final Recommendations published May 2022. The 11-LGD count is unchanged from the existing 2014 boundaries, but the lines themselves are redrawn. Includes electorate counts per district. These are recommendations from the Commission and may not yet be in legal force — verify current statutory status before using for official purposes.
